title: BEST APP EVER
body: I love Roubit. It’s my favourite application on my phone. I like how we get to take care of a bunny that grows when we make progress with our habits. I especially love the Dr. Eddy feature because it’s really useful and it helps me with my homework. I like how the app is very versatile and you can do many things. Sadly, sometimes it experiences bugs, like the support letter feature. Today I checked the “support letter feature” to send one and it claimed that it takes 10 minutes, but really it has been over an hour and when i clicked on my journal entry, it still says “waiting”. Please fix this!! Over all, amazing app.💖
author: J U L E S💖

title: Love Roubit🐰🥕
body: 안좋은 습관을 없애고 매일 작은 목표를 달성하기 위해 루틴 앱을 찾다가 루빗을 발견했어요. 일단 디자인이 너무 예쁘고 귀엽고 사용하기에 편리해요. 루빗이 응원해주고 당근으로 방을 꾸미는 것도 재밌어요. 또 루틴 리포트로 한 주 동안 얼마나 열심히 했는지 한눈에 볼 수 있는 것도 좋아요. 루빗이 있어서 행복해요🧡

title: Close to perfection
body: I really enjoy this app. It helps me a lot with mental health and to work on my good habits. It’s not like most journaling apps, this one i have a reason to come to it everyday. To take care of my little bunny friend and to see him grow. I don’t know why, but the little bunny helps so much. Sadly, its only a 7 days free trial. So i will lose everything that i made…
